title: Story Library Organizer
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Challenger Selling
description: Learners tag six customer stories by industry, persona, objection, deal stage, and product, and see each story become a searchable library card.

learningObjectives: Organize a story library by categorizing stories according to different dimensions (industry, persona, objection, stage, product).
prerequisites: Story Libraries, Industry-Specific Stories, and Persona-Specific Stories sections of Chapter 11

keyQuestions: Organize a story library by categorizing stories according to different dimensions (industry, persona, objection, stage, product).
assessmentOpportunities: All five tags correct for all six stories.
Learner can explain why one story can carry several tags.
